age.evidence: Adult male Sprague Dawley rats (Charles River Laboratories), aged 8 weeks on arrival

sex.evidence: Adult male Sprague Dawley rats (Charles River Laboratories), aged 8 weeks on arrival

dosing.evidence: 0.1, 1, or 3.0 mg/kg psilocybin... were administered intraperitoneally (IP) either 15 min (ketanserin, volinanserin) or 4 h (psilocybin) prior to the beginning of each SA or relapse session. On D9, 10 and 11 of heroin SA, rats received a single IP injection of psilocybin or vehicle 4 h prior to SA.

Ketanserin... were dissolved in 5% Tween-80, then diluted with sterile saline... 0.1, 1, or 3.0 mg/kg ketanserin... were administered intraperitoneally (IP) either 15 min... prior to the beginning of each SA or relapse session.

volinanserin... were dissolved in 5% Tween-80, then diluted with sterile saline... 0.04 or 0.2 mg/kg volinanserin were administered intraperitoneally (IP) either 15 min... prior to the beginning of each SA or relapse session.

group_housing.evidence: Rats were pair-housed upon arrival. Following intravenous catheter surgery, rats were single-housed for the remainder of the study.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Rats for SA were kept on a reverse light/dark cycle (lights on at 9:00 p.m.; off at 9:00 a.m.)

assays.assay_description: Intravenous heroin self-administration in operant chambers, 6 h daily sessions, FR1 schedule, 0.075 mg/kg/infusion. Active/inactive lever presses and infusions recorded across 8-11 days. Psilocybin, ketanserin, or volinanserin administered prior to SA on days 9-11.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (IP) either 15 min (ketanserin, volinanserin) or 4 h (psilocybin) prior to the beginning of each SA

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats self-administered heroin by lever pressing in operant chambers (freely moving).

food_restriction.evidence: Food was provided ad libitum, except where described.

time_to_assay.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (IP) either 15 min (ketanserin, volinanserin) or 4 h (psilocybin) prior to the beginning of each SA

sample_size.evidence: psilocybin administration during SA and relapse- vehicle n = 12; 0.1 mg/kg psilocybin n = 5; 1.0 mg/kg psilocybin n = 9; 3 mg/kg psilocybin n = 5

outcomes.summary: Pretreatment with psilocybin (0.1, 1, or 3 mg/kg, i.p.) 4 h prior to SA on days 9-11 did not alter heroin taking (lever presses or infusions). Ketanserin at 3 mg/kg increased heroin infusions in individual rats (paired comparison day 6-8 vs 9-11). Volinanserin did not alter heroin SA.
outcomes.statistics: RM-ANOVA: no main effect of psilocybin or psilocybin × time. Paired t test 3.0 mg/kg ketanserin: t(7) = 3.980, p = 0.005.
outcomes.evidence: RM-ANOVA analysis revealed no main effect of psilocybin treatment or psilocybin by time interactions for any dose of psilocybin compared to vehicle for either lever presses or infusions

B1_num_measures.evidence: active lever presses, inactive lever presses, and heroin infusions reported

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Drug infusions for rats in the 3.0 mg/kg ketanserin group was steady throughout the 6 h of SA, indicating ketanserin induced a consistent increase in heroin SA

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Lever pressing is not an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Rats tested alone in operant chamber.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Operant self-administration on FR1 schedule requires learning lever-drug association.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Lever presses recorded by operant chamber sensors only.

B8_multivariate.evidence: No multivariate analysis of behavioural data reported.

E3_bedding.evidence: Operant chambers have a bare floor; no bedding reported.

E6_spatial.evidence: Operant chamber is a single compartment.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water available in chamber during SA session.

D1_continuity.evidence: 6-hour daily sessions across 8-11 days of SA.

D3_recording_days.evidence: long-access heroin SA were performed... in 6-hour (hr) daily sessions... 8 days... On D9, 10 and 11 of heroin SA

D4_baseline.evidence: SA behavior for each treatment group, prior to psilocybin treatment for days 1-8.

D5_followup.evidence: Drug administered prior to each session; no >=24 h post-drug recording for the SA assay specifically.

D6_circadian.evidence: 6-hour daily sessions do not exceed 6 h.

assays.assay_description: 30-min cue-induced relapse test in the SA chamber following 17 or 21 days of forced abstinence. All drug-associated cues present but no heroin delivered. Active/inactive lever presses recorded across 1-3 consecutive relapse days. Rats received psilocybin (0.1-3 mg/kg, 4 h prior, or 3 mg/kg at 4 h or 24 h prior), ketanserin (0.1-3 mg/kg, 15 min prior), or volinanserin (0.04-0.2 mg/kg, 15 min prior).

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (IP) either 15 min (ketanserin, volinanserin) or 4 h (psilocybin) prior to... relapse session

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were again injected... prior to a 30-min cue-induced relapse test in the SA chamber

food_restriction.evidence: Food was provided ad libitum in home cage; SA chambers do not contain food.

water_restriction.evidence: Water not available in SA chamber during the 30-min relapse test.

time_to_assay.evidence: treated rats with 3.0 mg/kg psilocybin once, either 4 or 24 h prior to a relapse test; ketanserin/volinanserin 15 min prior

sample_size.evidence: psilocybin administration during SA and relapse- vehicle n = 12; 0.1 mg/kg psilocybin n = 5; 1.0 mg/kg psilocybin n = 9; 3 mg/kg psilocybin n = 5; psilocybin administration once, prior to relapse- vehicle n = 15; 3 mg/kg psilocybin, 4 h n = 8; 3 mg/kg psilocybin, 24 h n = 8; ketanserin... vehicle n = 12; 0.1 mg/kg n = 5; 1 mg/kg n = 7; 3 mg/kg n = 8; volinanserin- vehicle n = 6; 0.04 mg/kg n = 9; 0.2 mg/kg n = 10

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (3 mg/kg, 4 h prior) reduced active lever pressing during cue-induced relapse tests after 17 d abstinence (significant on relapse days 1 and 3). A single dose of 3 mg/kg psilocybin given 4 h or 24 h prior to a single relapse test after 21 d abstinence also significantly reduced active lever pressing. Ketanserin (3 mg/kg) increased active lever responses during relapse. Volinanserin (0.2 mg/kg) significantly elevated active lever responses across relapse tests.
outcomes.statistics: Psilocybin: Kruskal-Wallis R1 KW=8.33, p=0.04; R3 KW=7.85, p=0.049; RM-ANOVA vehicle vs 3 mg/kg active lever F(1,15)=5.60, p=0.032; single dose: KW=7.657, p=0.025; Dunn's: vehicle vs 3 mg/kg 4 h p=0.0379; vs 24 h p=0.0148. Ketanserin: R1 F(3,28)=5.116, p=0.006; R2 F(3,28)=4.548, p=0.010; RM-ANOVA F(1,18)=8.333, p=0.010. Volinanserin: R2 t(14)=2.352, p=0.034; RM-ANOVA F(1,15)=5.575, p=0.0322.
outcomes.evidence: a significant reduction in active lever responses observed for rats treated with 3 mg/kg psilocybin on days 1 and 3... Rats treated with 3.0 mg/kg ketanserin made more active lever presses compared to vehicle controls at the first two relapse tests... a significant main effect of 0.2 mg/kg volinanserin treatment compared to vehicle

B1_num_measures.evidence: active lever responses and inactive lever responses during relapse tests

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: No within-session time-course analysis reported; data are session totals across days.

B4_ethological.evidence: Lever pressing is not an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Single rat per chamber during relapse testing.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Cue-induced relapse test relies on learned association between cues and prior drug delivery.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Lever presses recorded by operant chamber sensors only.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Correlation analyses with gene expression done, but no multivariate behavioural analysis.

E1_environment_type.evidence: SA chambers used for relapse testing.

E6_spatial.evidence: Operant chamber is a single compartment.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in chamber during 30-min relapse test.

D1_continuity.evidence: rats were re-exposed to SA chambers for one or three 30-min relapse tests... in consecutive days

D3_recording_days.evidence: underwent 3 relapse tests on consecutive days (or single relapse test in follow-up cohort)

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline relapse session reported (relapse test was conducted after abstinence with drug pretreatment).

D5_followup.evidence: treated rats with 3.0 mg/kg psilocybin once, either 4 or 24 h prior to a relapse test - the 24 h cohort is >=24 h post drug

assays.assay_name: Cue-Induced Heroin Relapse Test with Intra-PFC IL-17a Antibody Infusion
assays.assay_description: 30-min cue-induced relapse test following 21 d forced abstinence after 10 d heroin SA. Rats received bilateral intra-PFC infusion of IL-17a monoclonal antibody (50 ng/hemisphere) or IgG control 48 h and 4 h before the relapse test. Active/inactive lever presses recorded.

application_type.evidence: Rats received bilateral infusions of either 50 ng/ul IL-17a monoclonal antibody, or an IgG control... into the medial PFC (intracerebral PFC infusion). Note: psilocybin not administered in this specific assay; intra-PFC infusion route reported here.

setup_restrain.evidence: rats underwent a 30-min relapse test in the SA chamber, freely moving

food_restriction.evidence: Food ad lib in home cage; SA chambers do not contain food during 30-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: Water not available during 30-min relapse test.

time_to_assay.evidence: the second infusion occurred on the day of the relapse test, four hours prior

sample_size.evidence: For PFC infusion of IL-17a antibody prior to relapse- IgG n = 8; IL-17a antibody n = 7.

outcomes.summary: Bilateral intra-PFC infusion of IL-17a monoclonal antibody significantly reduced active lever pressing during the cue-induced heroin relapse test compared to IgG controls, with no effect on inactive lever pressing. PFC Fos mRNA showed a trend for reduction and correlated negatively with active lever responses.
outcomes.statistics: Active lever: unpaired t test t(13)=2.187, p=0.048; Inactive lever: t(13)=0.083, p=0.934; Fos PFC Mann-Whitney U=12.50, p=0.07; Pearson R^2=0.316, p=0.0291.
outcomes.evidence: Selective infusion of IL-17a antibody into the PFC significantly reduced heroin seeking behavior during the relapse test, as measured by reduced active lever responses (unpaired t test, t(13) = 2.187, p = 0.048)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Active and inactive lever presses during the relapse test.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Cue-induced relapse relies on learned cue-drug association.

E1_environment_type.evidence: SA chambers used for relapse testing.

E6_spatial.evidence: Operant chamber is a single compartment.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in chamber during test.

D1_continuity.evidence: a 30 min cue-induced relapse test (single relapse session in this experiment)

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single relapse test day for this assay.

D5_followup.evidence: Test performed 4 h after final infusion; brains collected within 90 min after test.

judge_notes: Three candidates differed on assay granularity. Consolidated to three distinct behavioural assays: (1) Heroin Self-Administration (6 h operant SA across 8-11 days), (2) Cue-Induced Heroin Relapse Test (30-min cue tests after forced abstinence, with psilocybin/ketanserin/volinanserin pretreatment - all merged as one assay per rubric since same apparatus + paradigm + measures, only manipulation differs), and (3) the intra-PFC IL-17a antibody relapse test (separated because the manipulation is intracerebral antibody infusion, but it remains the same cue-induced relapse paradigm - kept separate because IL-17a is not a psychedelic but is downstream mechanism testing; arguably could merge with assay 2 - kept separate to preserve the distinct mechanistic experiment).
Added Ketanserin and Volinanserin to dosing list since they were systemically administered to behaving rats in the relapse/SA assays alongside psilocybin.

B2 for SA assay scored 1 (Yes) because the paper reports within-session time-course of infusions across the 6 h SA ('Drug infusions for rats in the 3.0 mg/kg ketanserin group was steady throughout the 6 h of SA'); B2 for relapse scored 0 (session totals only).
D5 for SA assay scored 0 since each dosing day was followed immediately by SA; for the relapse assay scored 1 because the 24-h-prior psilocybin cohort represents >=24 h post-drug recording.
Sex n_male/n_female filled at assay level based on total subject counts since all subjects were male.
